headline: Sir Patrick Stewart Dies at 86
deck: The actor’s career moved from the British stage to Star Trek and X-Men.
body: An Instagram post said Sir Patrick Stewart died aged 86 following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia. [E1]
The post said Stewart died on Wednesday at his home in Los Angeles while in the loving care of his wife, Sunny. [E2]
Stewart made the transition from a British stage veteran to a science-fiction icon through Star Trek and X-Men, The Hollywood Reporter wrote. [E3]
He played Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men films. [E4]
Stewart is survived by his wife and two children, Daniel and Sophie. [E5]
